; -*- mode: Org;-*-

#+TITLE: 09 build ubuntu 26.04 package
#+STARTUP: overview

* Dev process setup
  Before executing ANY work item in this plan, open and obey
  the rules defined in this project's per-repo instructions:

    - .github/copilot-instructions.md  (mirrored in CLAUDE.md)

  Both auto-load into every GHCP CLI session.  Read the current
  rules there and follow them.  This plan intentionally does
  not restate any rule — the per-repo instructions are the
  single source of truth.

* Goal [7/7]
      Complete the new, dedicated Docker-based Ubuntu 26.04 amd64 builder and
      produce a relocatable Emacs package:

        amd64.emacs30.1_26.04.tar.gz

      The package must install with:

        tar -zxf amd64.emacs30.1_26.04.tar.gz -C /

      Success criteria:
      - [X] The self-contained Ubuntu 26.04 image builds reproducibly with
            Docker for linux/amd64; nothing is compiled on the host.
      - [X] The package contains Emacs 30.1, tree-sitter v0.24.7, native
            compilation, and the pinned emacs-libvterm module.
      - [X] The manifest is generated from the completed 26.04 image and
            contains no aarch64 paths or binaries.
      - [X] The package excludes the target's core glibc files
            (libc.so.6, libm.so.6, and ld-linux-x86-64.so.2).
      - [X] Root extraction in a separate clean ubuntu:26.04 container
            preserves the target glibc checksums and leaves no missing
            runtime libraries.
      - [X] The packaged /root/.bashrc preserves the current WSL shell
            behavior: provider URL http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1, no global
            COPILOT_MODEL pin, ghe using GitHub gpt-5.6-sol, and h selecting
            a model from the live provider catalog.
      - [X] The clean-container smoke test prints
            EMACS_26_04_VERIFY_OK after Emacs, native-comp, tree-sitter,
            vterm, architecture, shell configuration, and root-extraction
            checks pass.

* Dependencies
      - Rebuilt Ubuntu 26.04 WSL on x86_64 with Docker available.
      - Ubuntu base image:
            ubuntu:26.04
      - Existing in-progress builder:

            (link "/workspace/dot-emacs/build/emacs-30.1-treesitter-ubuntu-26.04/pack.sh" 1)
            (link "/workspace/dot-emacs/build/emacs-30.1-treesitter-ubuntu-26.04/verify.sh" 1)
      - Proven Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 builder, used only as structural reference:
            (link "/workspace/dot-emacs/build/emacs-30.1-treesitter-ubuntu-24.04/Dockerfile" 1)
      - Durable Ubuntu 26.04 findings:
            (link "/workspace/dot-emacs/.github/REPL/fix.archive/glibc-private-symbol-wsl26-vs-container24.md" 1)
            (link "/workspace/dot-emacs/.github/REPL/fix.archive/emacs-30.1-ubuntu-26.04-build.md" 1)
      - Current rebuilt-WSL shell configuration, used as the source of truth
        for the provision block packaged as /root/.bashrc:
            (link "/root/.bashrc" 3400)
      - Load-bearing source pins; do not change without a new user decision:
            - Emacs 30.1
            - TREE_SITTER_TAG=v0.24.7
            - EMACS_LIBVTERM_COMMIT=54c29d14bca05bdd8ae60cda01715d727831e3f9
      - Ubuntu 26.04 native-comp compiler set currently selected:
            - gcc-14=14.3.0-14ubuntu1
            - libgccjit0=14.3.0-14ubuntu1
            - libgccjit-14-dev=14.3.0-14ubuntu1
      - Shell-helper runtime:
            - curl (already present)
            - jq=1.8.1-4ubuntu2, required by h() to parse /v1/models

* Context
      Facts established on 2026-09-14:

      - The whole WSL distro has already been rebuilt as clean Ubuntu 26.04.
        Rebuilding or repairing WSL is not part of this plan. Use the rebuilt
        WSL only as the Docker host and final target.

      - The Ubuntu 24.04 package is not safe to install over Ubuntu 26.04.
        Its bundled glibc 2.39 files can create a mixed loader/runtime stack
        on a glibc 2.43 target and trigger a GLIBC_PRIVATE symbol failure.

      - A dedicated sibling builder already exists at:
            build/emacs-30.1-treesitter-ubuntu-26.04/
        It is the wholly separate build folder requested for this work. Keep
        the proven 24.04, arm64, and Arcadia folders unchanged.

      - Scope is Ubuntu 26.04 linux/amd64 Emacs packaging only. Do not add a
        devbox flavor, an arm64 flavor, or unrelated language toolchains.
        Arcadia is already correct for its Azure Linux target and is out of
        scope.

      - The current build log stops during the Emacs build after Docker step
        15 completed; it does not show a completed image export. No
        amd64.emacs30.1_26.04.tar.gz artifact exists yet.

      - amd64.tar.list and amd64.tar.list.template both currently contain
        13,832 entries inherited as a starting point. The final manifest must
        be refreshed against the completed 26.04 image rather than trusted
        as-is.

      - build.sh is not currently executable. The other build, manifest,
        pack, and verify scripts are executable.

      - The verify script already protects the clean target's loader,
        libc.so.6, and libm.so.6 with before/after checksums. Extend it only
        where needed to make the Goal's native-comp and tree-sitter checks
        explicit.

      - The current rebuilt-WSL ~/.bashrc provision block is authoritative:
            - COPILOT_PROVIDER_TYPE=openai
            - COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
            - COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_KEY=ollama
            - no global COPILOT_MODEL export
            - ghe removes provider/model overrides and invokes GitHub
              Copilot with --model gpt-5.6-sol --effort high,
              --context long_context, --allow-all, and --resume
            - h() fetches ${COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL%/}/models, parses model
              IDs with jq, accepts an explicit model or interactive choice,
              clears stale model override variables, and execs Copilot with
              the selected provider model.

      :decision: Package the current rebuilt-WSL ghe and h behavior, including
                 jq=1.8.1-4ubuntu2, because the user explicitly requires the
                 current ~/.bashrc, right loopback endpoint, and model setup.
      :rejected: host.docker.internal or a hard-coded WSL address -- the
                 rebuilt WSL uses mirrored networking and the current working
                 endpoint is 127.0.0.1.
      :rejected: A global hard-coded Claude model -- ghe must use GitHub
                 gpt-5.6-sol and h must select from the provider catalog.

      :decision: Build only from the dedicated
                 build/emacs-30.1-treesitter-ubuntu-26.04/ folder.
      :rejected: Modify the 24.04 or Arcadia builders -- those are separate
                 target flavors and must remain intact.

      - The rebuilt WSL host is x86_64 and matches the linux/amd64 target.
        Build natively with plain docker build; do not use buildx, QEMU, or a
        cross-platform build path.

      - A clean Docker container can verify that the packaged .bashrc sources
        and defines the correct helpers, but its own 127.0.0.1 is not the WSL
        host. Probe the live /v1/models endpoint separately in rebuilt WSL
        after the clean-container package test passes.

      - Any new package, package-version substitution, source download, or pin
        change beyond the dependency set documented above requires an
        explicit user decision before editing or rebuilding.

* Main Loop :test_tool:
      Test tool = verify.sh running in a SEPARATE shell from the Docker build
      and packaging shell.

      Shell A builds and packages:
      #+BEGIN_SRC sh
        cd /workspace/dot-emacs/build/emacs-30.1-treesitter-ubuntu-26.04
        ./build.sh
        ./refresh-amd64-tar-list.sh
        ./pack.sh
        sha256sum amd64.emacs30.1_26.04.tar.gz
      #+END_SRC

      Shell B verifies the completed artifact in a fresh container:
      #+BEGIN_SRC sh
        cd /workspace/dot-emacs/build/emacs-30.1-treesitter-ubuntu-26.04
        ./verify.sh amd64.emacs30.1_26.04.tar.gz
      #+END_SRC

      Iterate:
      - (R) Read the build, manifest, pack, or verify failure.
      - (E) Make the smallest correction in the 26.04 builder.
      - (P) Rebuild/repack in shell A, then rerun verify.sh in shell B.
      - (L) Stop only when verify.sh prints EMACS_26_04_VERIFY_OK and every
            Goal checkbox is [X].

* DONE Reconcile the existing 26.04 builder [5/5]
      - [X] Confirm the rebuilt WSL host is healthy before using Docker:
            #+BEGIN_SRC sh
              test "$(uname -m)" = x86_64
              ldd --version | head -1
              /bin/true
              docker info >/dev/null
            #+END_SRC
            :test_tool: WSL is x86_64, reports glibc 2.43, executes
                        /bin/true, and reaches Docker.

      - [X] Review the in-progress sibling against the 24.04 reference and
            keep only changes required by Ubuntu 26.04, artifact naming, and
            safe glibc handling.
            - Preserve the source pins listed in * Dependencies.
            - Preserve the separate builder folder; do not edit the 24.04
              flavor.
            - Ensure all scripts use caapi/amd64.emacs30.1:26.04 and the
              26.04 artifact name consistently.
            - Make build.sh use native plain docker build; do not use buildx,
              QEMU, or --platform for this matching x86_64 host/target.

      - [X] Confirm the documented native-comp package candidates in an
            unmodified ubuntu:26.04 container before the next image build:
            #+BEGIN_SRC sh
              docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 ubuntu:26.04 bash -lc '
                apt-get update -qq
                apt-cache policy gcc-14 libgccjit0 libgccjit-14-dev'
            #+END_SRC
            :test_tool: All three candidates resolve to 14.3.0-14ubuntu1.
            :interrupt: If a candidate differs or is unavailable, state the
                        exact package, version, and reason, then ask before
                        changing the Dockerfile or any pin.

      - [X] Align the packaged .bashrc with the current rebuilt-WSL
            ~/.bashrc before building.
            - Preserve the existing Emacs PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, and e/ed/ec
              definitions.
            - Use http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1; do not use
              host.docker.internal or a numeric WSL address.
            - Do not export COPILOT_MODEL globally.
            - Include ghe with gpt-5.6-sol, high effort, long_context,
              provider-variable removal, --allow-all, and --resume.
            - Include h() as the catalog-selecting shell function, not the
              obsolete plain alias.
            - Add jq=1.8.1-4ubuntu2 to the Dockerfile; curl is already present.
            (link "/root/.bashrc" 3400)
            (link "/workspace/dot-emacs/build/emacs-30.1-treesitter-ubuntu-26.04/.bashrc" 1)
            :test_tool: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 ubuntu:26.04 bash -lc 'apt-get update -qq && apt-cache policy jq | grep -F "Candidate: 1.8.1-4ubuntu2"'
            :test_tool: bash -ic 'curl -fsS "${COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL%/}/models" | jq -e ".data | length > 0"; type ghe; type h; test -z "${COPILOT_MODEL+x}"'
            :interrupt: If the rebuilt WSL loopback provider is unavailable,
                        diagnose its service/networking; do not substitute a
                        guessed IP or model.

      - [X] Make the driver scripts reliably executable and fail-fast.
            - Add executable permission to build.sh.
            - Keep set -euo pipefail in scripts that perform build, manifest,
              package, or verification work.
            :test_tool: stat -c '%A %n' build.sh pack.sh tar.sh verify.sh refresh-amd64-tar-list.sh

* DONE Complete the Docker image [3/3]
      - [X] Build caapi/amd64.emacs30.1:26.04 in shell A.
            #+BEGIN_SRC sh
              cd /workspace/dot-emacs/build/emacs-30.1-treesitter-ubuntu-26.04
              ./build.sh
            #+END_SRC
            - Keep build output outside committed source; build.26.04.log is a
              local diagnostic, not a deliverable.
            :test_tool: docker image inspect caapi/amd64.emacs30.1:26.04

      - [X] Run read-only checks inside the completed image:
            #+BEGIN_SRC sh
              docker run --rm --entrypoint bash \
                caapi/amd64.emacs30.1:26.04 -lc '
                  ldd --version | head -1
                  file /root/local/bin/emacs
                  /root/local/bin/emacs -Q --batch \
                    --eval "(princ emacs-version)"
                  /root/local/bin/emacs -Q --batch \
                    --eval "(princ (if (native-comp-available-p) \"NATIVE_COMP_OK\" \"NATIVE_COMP_MISSING\"))"
                  /root/local/bin/emacs -Q --batch \
                    --eval "(princ (if (treesit-available-p) \"TREESIT_OK\" \"TREESIT_MISSING\"))"'

              docker run --rm --entrypoint bash \
                caapi/amd64.emacs30.1:26.04 -ic '
                  test "$COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL" = "http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1"
                  test -z "${COPILOT_MODEL+x}"
                  command -v curl
                  command -v jq
                  type ghe
                  type h
                  alias ghe | grep -F -- "--model gpt-5.6-sol"
                  alias ghe | grep -F -- "--effort high"
                  alias ghe | grep -F -- "--context long_context"'
            #+END_SRC
            :test_tool: glibc is 2.43, Emacs is 30.1 and x86-64, and both
                        NATIVE_COMP_OK and TREESIT_OK are printed; the shell
                        assertions also exit zero.

      - [X] Confirm the pinned vterm module loads in the image before
            packaging.
            :test_tool: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --entrypoint /root/local/bin/emacs caapi/amd64.emacs30.1:26.04 -Q --batch --eval '(add-to-list (quote load-path) "/root/etc/el/vendor/vterm")' --eval '(require (quote vterm))' --eval '(princ "VTERM_OK")'

* DONE Generate the root-extractable package [4/4]
      - [X] Regenerate amd64.tar.list from the completed image.
            #+BEGIN_SRC sh
              cd /workspace/dot-emacs/build/emacs-30.1-treesitter-ubuntu-26.04
              ./refresh-amd64-tar-list.sh
            #+END_SRC
            :test_tool: The script prints MANIFEST_OK and reports no unmapped
                        required entries.

      - [X] Audit the generated manifest before packaging.
            #+BEGIN_SRC sh
              ! grep -Eq '(^|/)(libc\.so\.6|libm\.so\.6|ld-linux-x86-64\.so\.2)$' amd64.tar.list
              ! grep -Eqi 'aarch64|aarch64-linux-gnu' amd64.tar.list
              grep -qx 'root/local' amd64.tar.list
              grep -qx 'root/etc/el' amd64.tar.list
              grep -qx 'usr/local/lib/libtree-sitter.so.0.24' amd64.tar.list
              grep -qx 'usr/bin/jq' amd64.tar.list
            #+END_SRC
            :test_tool: All commands exit zero.
            - If jq or an ldd-reported jq runtime dependency is absent from
              the inherited template, add its Ubuntu 26.04 package-owned
              runtime path to amd64.tar.list.template and regenerate. Do not
              hand-edit only the generated amd64.tar.list.

      - [X] Package from / inside the image using the explicit manifest.
            #+BEGIN_SRC sh
              ./pack.sh
            #+END_SRC
            :test_tool: test -s amd64.emacs30.1_26.04.tar.gz

      - [X] Inspect the tarball without extracting it.
            #+BEGIN_SRC sh
              tar tzf amd64.emacs30.1_26.04.tar.gz > /tmp/emacs-26.04.tar.paths
              grep -q '^root/local/' /tmp/emacs-26.04.tar.paths
              grep -q '^root/etc/el/' /tmp/emacs-26.04.tar.paths
              ! grep -Eq '(^|/)(libc\.so\.6|libm\.so\.6|ld-linux-x86-64\.so\.2)$' /tmp/emacs-26.04.tar.paths
              ! grep -Eqi 'aarch64|aarch64-linux-gnu' /tmp/emacs-26.04.tar.paths
            #+END_SRC
            :test_tool: All commands exit zero; there is no extra top-level
                        packaging directory.

* DONE Verify in a separate clean Ubuntu 26.04 container [3/3]
      - [X] Extend verify.sh with explicit native-comp and tree-sitter
            availability assertions plus interactive-shell assertions for
            the provider URL, absence of a global model pin, curl/jq, ghe,
            and h. Preserve its glibc checksum, architecture, ldd, Emacs, and
            vterm checks.
            :test_tool: bash -n verify.sh

      - [X] From shell B, run the read-only package smoke test:
            #+BEGIN_SRC sh
              ./verify.sh amd64.emacs30.1_26.04.tar.gz
            #+END_SRC
            The test must:
            - start from a fresh ubuntu:26.04 linux/amd64 container;
            - checksum the target loader, libc.so.6, and libm.so.6 before and
              after root extraction;
            - run ldconfig and reject missing ldd dependencies;
            - prove Emacs and vterm are x86-64, not aarch64;
            - run Emacs 30.1, native-comp, tree-sitter, and vterm checks;
            - source /root/.bashrc with bash -ic and prove:
              - COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL is http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1;
              - COPILOT_MODEL is not globally set;
              - curl and jq resolve;
              - ghe names gpt-5.6-sol, high effort, and long_context;
              - h is a shell function, not the obsolete plain alias.
            :test_tool: The final line is EMACS_26_04_VERIFY_OK.

      - [X] If verification fails, repeat the * Main Loop without weakening
            an assertion or copying core glibc files into the artifact.
            - Not needed: the first complete clean-container verification
              passed and printed EMACS_26_04_VERIFY_OK.
            :interrupt: If success appears to require a new apt package,
                        source download, version substitution, or pin change,
                        state its exact version and purpose and ask the user
                        before changing the builder.
